Name: Water Your Crops
Author: chiccenSDV
Description:
Water Your Crops is yet another mod that changes the visual cue for when crops haven't been watered yet.

DESCRIPTION
===========

This mod provides the following features to remind you to water your crops:

[list]
[*]A daily message reminder for both the farm outside Pelican Town and Ginger island
[*]A customizable indicator shown on all crops that require water, modeled after object placement indicator
[/list]
The default configuration is:
[code]EnableMod = true
OnlyWaterCan = true
IndicatorColor = Color.LightPink
IndicatorOpacity = 1f
Debug = false
[/code]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/k7LzZH0.gif[/img]

You can edit the config in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or by editing the mod's config.json file after starting the game once.
To change the water indicator color, you must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10505]Generic Mod Config Menu Options[/url] installed. This is highly recommended as by default, the color will be set to light pink, and it can be quite difficult to change without GMCM Options.
